interruption_reason: The official archive uses both an additional cm201012 directory for part of 2010–2011 and, on some sitting days, only the comprehensive /indexes/dxYYMMDD.html route rather than a dedicated written-answer index. Continuing either diagnostic run unchanged would have produced avoidable invalid requests.
change: Added cm201012 as a bounded session candidate, added the comprehensive daily-index route after the dedicated route, restricted its parser to the Written Answers section, and retained a verified-cache preflight so successful HTML and fetch metadata are reused before unresolved dates are tried.
